subject: Request: temporary rate ceiling & launch handoff for Olive Labs pilot
messages:
From: Sam Wallis <sam.wallis@olivelabs.com>
To: david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot go-live and temporary token ceiling request

Hi David,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Our engineering lead ran the latest traffic sim and we need to confirm a temporary token ceiling for the pilot go-live on Sept 15. Short summary:

- Target ramp: 10k users first 48 hours, avg 1.4k tokens/s peak across endpoints
- We expect bursts up to ~3.2k tokens/s for short periods (10-15 minutes)
- Primary concern: chat endpoint with streaming responses and tool calls

Can Redwood temporarily lift the per-minute token ceiling or provide a controlled bump for the pilot window (Sept 15-18)? If so, we need a preflight quota and an ops contact to escalate to during the first 24 hours. I attached the traffic forecast.

Also: do you have any recommended warmup cadence to avoid cold KV cache impact?

Best,
Sam
Sr. Platform PM
Olive Labs

Attachments: pilot-ingress-forecast.xlsx (xlsx, 82KB)

From: david_kim@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot go-live and temporary token ceiling request

Team — forwarding Olive Labs' ask. Quick needs:

1) Can infra/serving support a temporary per-minute token ceiling increase to handle ~3.5k tokens/s burst headroom for Sept 15-18? We should plan for controlled knob (timeboxed) not a permanent quota change.
2) Product: any recommended warmup cadence and KV cache pre-warm strategy we should prescribe to the customer?
3) Ops: who will be the escalation owner during the 0-24h after go-live (our on-call might need a POA)

Proposed plan:
- Approve a timeboxed ceiling increase (72h window) with a staged ramp: 30% -> 60% -> full expected traffic across 6 hours
- Assign an on-call escalation point and a playbook (simple runbook)
- Provide the customer a short warmup checklist (suggested spike schedule, batching configs, recommended quantization variant)

Can you confirm feasibility and we will push a temporary waiver doc?

Thanks,
David
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

-----Original message attached-----
(see above)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: david_kim@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot go-live and temporary token ceiling request

David —

Infra/Serving feasibility notes:

- Short answer: yes, we can support a timeboxed ceiling bump for the pilot window. We'll gate by capacity reservations on the Dedicated pool and a soft-fallback to the hosted lower-cost variant if we see sustained overrun.
- Recommend we define token ceiling as a per-minute token allocation and a concurrent session cap for streaming endpoints to limit tail risk.
- Staged ramp: we agree with your 30/60/100% cadence but suggest extending ramp to 12 hours for safety unless Olive confirms synthetic warmups.

Product questions for Lauren/Marissa:
- Which model variant should we recommend? The customer's latency requirement is 350-450ms p50 on chat. We can push them to a quantized variant that preserves p50 and reduces unit cost.
- Do we allow them to enable prefix caching and pre-populate KV entries? If yes, we need an API key for prewarm runs and a short window to seed caches.

Ops: assigning on-call — Grace, can you take escalation ownership for Sept 15 00:00-12:00 PDT and coordinate handoff to the usual SRE on-call afterwards?

Karthik
Sr. PM, Field Ops
Redwood Inference

> > Team — forwarding Olive Labs' ask. Quick needs:
> > ...

From: david_kim@redwood.com
To: Sam Wallis <sam.wallis@olivelabs.com>, Olive Labs <ops@olivelabs.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot go-live and temporary token ceiling request — plan and next steps

Hi Sam,

Thanks for the forecast — we've reviewed and can proceed with a timeboxed ceiling bump and a runbook for the Sept 15 pilot. Summary of what Redwood will provide and next steps:

- Temporary ceiling: increase to a per-minute token allocation equivalent to ~4,000 tokens/s sustained (to provide buffer vs your 3.2k burst) for a 72-hour window starting Sept 15 00:00 PDT. This is a temporary waiver and will be auto-reverted after the window.
- Ramp cadence: we recommend the following staged handoff unless you run synthetic warmups: 12:00 -> 40% for 2h -> 70% for 4h -> full traffic. If you can do scripted warmups, we can shorten to your proposed 6h cadence.
- Model recommendation: lauren_bishop suggests using the quantized-v2 chat variant (p50 target 380ms) for the pilot. We'll include guidance on batching and streaming concurrency limits.
- Prewarm: we can provide an API key scoped to cache-seeding calls. We'll need your CI job ID and a short list of prompt families to seed KV entries.
- Ops escalation: grace_oconnor will be primary escalation contact for the initial 12h (Sept 15 00:00-12:00 PDT). Karthik will monitor runway and scale policies.

Action items for Olive Labs:
- Confirm acceptance of the 72-hour window and ramp cadence by EOD Sept 10
- Share the CI job ID and sample prompt families to enable prewarm
- Review attached temporary waiver (temp-rate-waiver.docx) and sign if approved

We'll also upload a one-page runbook to the Drive link and add this to the HubSpot deal. Please reply to confirm and we'll lock in the waiver.

Best,
David Kim
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: temp-rate-waiver.docx (docx, 14KB)
